segmentation.text: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow:
Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (b) [NRS-484B-307-9b],
only to make the movement indicated by the green turn arrow,
to pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.
Drivers turning in the direction of the arrow are thereby advised that so long as the turn arrow is illuminated, oncoming or opposing traffic simultaneously faces a steady red signal.

elements.justification: dev.traffic_signal: "a signal head; state ∈ {circular_green, circular_yellow, circular_red, green_arrow(dir), ...}" and "several states may be displayed at once": a steady red with a green turn arrow is a head displaying circular_red together with green_arrow(dir), dir left or right. 'The signal' is the head tied to the subject's approach in span b4. No 'not a stand-in' clause applies.

The entry: drv.motion.entering_region: "Road user x enters structure region r at the observation: its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before"; r is the st.intersection, "the region where two roadways meet". The permission to enter is the one paragraph (b) (span b2) qualifies for the road users it names: what it otherwise provides is a permission that exists only 'if' its conditions hold: "may proceed straight through or turn in the direction opposite that indicated by the green turn arrow if: (1) The person stops before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection where the sign or pavement marking indicates where the stop must be made or, in the absence of any such crosswalk, sign or marking, before entering the intersection; (2) ... (3) ... and (4) ...". The exception therefore carries the class and the movement of paragraph (b) (through the composition on b2, rule applies) together with its conditions as facts; condition (1), the act itself, is carried here in full, read by the same atoms the mapping index gives those words for NRS_484B_307_9b_o1. drv.motion.halted: "A road user is at a standstill at the observation" ("complete cessation from movement", kin.speed at or below speed_floor); the place: st.stop_line ("the transverse line marking where vehicles halt for a device") or st.crosswalk ("marked crossing, or the unmarked prolongation of sidewalks at an intersection") tied to the approach carrier by st.entrance_of ("the carrier whose entrance into an intersection a stop line or a crosswalk marks"), the carrier c (st.travel_region, rel.occupies) entering st.intersection i by st.lane_enters ("the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end"); the distance to the place is st.region_geometry ("the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it"), the side of the place along c's designated direction prim.region_offset_along ("the signed distance (m) from a road user's reference point ... measured along a carrier's designated direction"). Not stand-ins: halted is not where or why the road user stands, which the place relations state; st.entrance_of is not a distance, which st.region_geometry gives; prim.region_offset_along is read only for the side, never as the distance to the mark; st.intersection is not a crosswalk or a stop line, each read on its own.

'traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic ("pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances either singly or together using any highway for purposes of travel"). The law's own qualifier 'vehicular' is the adjective of the defined word 'vehicle', whose posted definition applies to this law: DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, "every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway, except: (1) Devices moved by human power or used exclusively upon stationary rails; (2) Electric bicycles; (3) Electric personal assistive mobility devices ...; and (4) An electric scooter." The qualifier leaves out of the traffic aggregate its members that are not vehicles: pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, and the conveyances the definition excepts (bicycles and other human-powered devices, electric bicycles, electric personal assistive mobility devices, electric scooters, rail-bound devices). Those exclusions are the definition's own, which the reading of the aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle carries, so the rule adds no condition beside it. The subject carries both aggregates, as in the accepted sibling NRS_484B_307_9a_o2. Motorcycles and mopeds remain vehicles, and paragraph (b) is the exception for them.

Facing the signal is the signal governing the approach the subject entered through. dev.governs: "the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection, read as control of the junction itself"; st.lane_enters: "the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end". The approach carrier c (st.travel_region) is the one x occupied (rel.occupies) at the observation of its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region: "its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before"), read through a past operator, with st.lane_enters(c, i); the signal governs c or i. dev.governs is 'not a stand-in' for a position and is not used as one.

The movement made through the intersection is read at x's leaving of it (drv.motion.leaving_region: "its footprint overlapped r (rel.occupies) at the observation before and does not overlap it at the observation") by drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry: "The signed heading change of road user x since its footprint last began to overlap region r, in degrees, left positive", integrated from kin.yaw_rate. A left arrow indicates a change of at least the turn recognition angle to the left, a right arrow one to the right. The concept is 'not' a turn by itself; the rule compares it with its own bound.

residues.why: An advisory to drivers turning with the arrow about what opposing traffic faces at the same time; it permits, requires and forbids nothing, and no rule reads it.

applicability: x carries ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic and ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle (vehicular traffic, the binder's class); at the observation x leaves an intersection i (drv.motion.leaving_region(x, i)); read through a past operator from that leaving, x occupied i at every observation from its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region(x, i)) to the one before the leaving, and at that entry observation x occupied a carrier c (st.travel_region, rel.occupies(x, c)) with st.lane_enters(c, i) while a traffic signal s that governs c or i (dev.governs) displayed circular_red together with green_arrow(d), d left or right. Where the entry lies before the recording the applicability is unknown. EXCEPTION (paragraph (b)'s permission; the duty is not engaged only where all of the following hold, a conjunction): (E1) NRS_484B_307_9b_o1 applies to x (ruleApplies, map x→x: its classes, the same entry, signal and leaving, and the straight-through or opposite movement); (E2) condition (1) of paragraph (b) is met as a fact, written in this node's formula (not through the composed rule's verdict, which counts as complied where engagement is unknown): a halt before the entry, searched in the past by the approach convention — event: x's entry into i named above, made through carrier c; place, in order: a stop line recorded as marking c (st.entrance_of(line, c)); where c's marks are observed and include no stop line, a crosswalk recorded as marking c; where neither is recorded for c, the entrance end of c at i; act: an observation at which x is halted (drv.motion.halted with p.speed_resolution) while occupying c, its body within p.stop_point_tolerance of the place (st.region_geometry distance), not past it along c's designated direction (prim.region_offset_along of the place from x not negative), and its footprint overlapping neither i nor, where the place is a crosswalk, that crosswalk; search: back from the entry, ending at the approach start (the last observation before the entry at which x, on c, is outside the place's stopping zone upstream: off the mark, short of it and farther from it than p.stop_point_tolerance) or at x's previous entry into i, nothing else ending it; found → E2 true; either end reached without the act → E2 false; neither end reached (the recording begins inside the approach), or c's association with a mark, c's direction or x's place relative to the mark unobserved where the outcome turns on it → E2 unknown; (E3) NRS_484B_307_9b_o2, NRS_484B_307_9b_o3 and NRS_484B_307_9b_o4 are complied with by x (rule, map x→x): conditions (2), (3) and (4). The exception is the conjunction E1 ∧ E2 ∧ E3, so a road user whose class under paragraph (b) is unresolved but which made no halt (E2 false) is not excused.
obligation: For every intersection i selected as in the applicability (x leaves i at the observation, having entered it last under a steady red with a green arrow on a signal governing its approach carrier c or i): at that leaving observation the heading change of x since that entry (drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry(x, i) with step p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph) shows the movement a green arrow displayed at the entry indicates: at least p.turn_recognition_angle where d is left, at most minus p.turn_recognition_angle where d is right. Where arrows of both directions were displayed, the movement either indicates complies.

narrowings.why: The movement indicated by the arrow is read as the side and the size of the heading change through the intersection, judged when the subject leaves it: a passage turning at least the turn recognition angle toward the arrow's side complies, whatever lane it exits into.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.bus, a vehicle of no class paragraph (b) names), recorded from well upstream on lane c, whose entrance into intersection i is marked by a stop line (st.entrance_of observed, c's st.lane_direction observed), passes the stop line moving without ever halting and enters i while signal s governing c displays circular_red with green_arrow(left); x crosses i and leaves it with a heading change since entry well inside p.turn_recognition_angle (straight through). The exception fails on E2 (no halt; the search reaches the approach start), whatever x's class under paragraph (b).

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.bus), recorded from upstream, makes the same entry under circular_red with green_arrow(left) without halting; x leaves i with a heading change since entry above p.turn_recognition_angle to the left.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.bus): s displays circular_green at x's entry into i; x crosses straight through.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.bus), recorded from upstream on lane c with a stop line marking c, passes the line without halting, enters i and crosses straight through, but the source does not observe s's state at the entry.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but x is a ru.motorcycle (a vehicle, and a motorcycle under paragraph (b)): NRS_484B_307_9b_o1 applies, but x made no halt before the stop line, so paragraph (b)'s permission does not hold and this duty is judged: straight through under a left arrow is violated. Differs from forbid only in x's class.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: x is a ru.bicycle, a device moved by human power and so no vehicle: it is not vehicular traffic; it enters i under circular_red with green_arrow(left) and leaves after a left turn.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.bus), recorded from upstream, passes the stop line of lane c without halting, enters i under circular_red with green_arrow(right) on s governing c, and leaves i after a left turn (heading change above p.turn_recognition_angle to the left).

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.bus) enters i under circular_red with green_arrow(right) and leaves i after a right turn (heading change at most minus p.turn_recognition_angle).

scenarios.name: branch_5
scenarios.narrative: s governs the intersection i itself, not the approach lane; it displays circular_red with green_arrow(left) at x's (ru.bus) entry; x, recorded from upstream, passed the stop line of its lane c without halting and crosses straight through.

scenarios.name: branch_6
scenarios.narrative: As branch_1 (x a ru.motorcycle, straight through under a left arrow), but x halts on c at the stop line within p.stop_point_tolerance before it, then meets paragraph (b)'s further conditions as NRS_484B_307_9b_o2, NRS_484B_307_9b_o3 and NRS_484B_307_9b_o4 read them (it waits there through two complete cycles in which the signal does not change for it, no other device prohibits the movement, and no pedestrian or other road user is in the scene): the permission holds and this duty is not engaged. Differs from branch_1 only in the facts of paragraph (b)'s conditions.

scenarios.name: history_boundary
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.bus) is first observed on lane c already inside the approach to i (past where its approach start would lie), moving; it passes the stop line without a recorded halt, enters i under circular_red with green_arrow(left) and crosses straight through. Whether a halt before the recording met condition (1) is undecided, and x's class under paragraph (b) is unresolved, so the exception is unknown.
scenarios.boundary: the approach start on lane c before x's entry into i, and any halt at the stop line before the recording began
